Questa Posizione Risponde a Global Marketing and Communications Manager, Drive Products __ ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing and circular solutions for customers, industries and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion Location This role is open globally, but location is set in Europe - with a preference for Finland (Helsinki), Italy (Sesto San Giovanni), Germany (Mannheim) - and US (New Berlin, Wisconsin). The work model is hybrid . Key Responsibilities In this role, you will lead global marketing and communications for industrial drives portfolio, including portfolio promotion and new product launches, deepen OEM partnerships and create compelling storytelling. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help strengthen market positioning, support business growth, and ensure marketing initiatives deliver measurable impact across global markets. This role reports to Global Marketing and Communication Manager, Motion Drive Products. You Will Be Mainly Accountable For Develop and execute annual global marketing and communications plans and roadmaps for industrial segment and applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives. Lead end-to-end global product launches and marketing campaigns, ensuring consistent execution and measurable business impact across markets. Manage marketing budget allocation, set targets and monitor campaign performance metrics, providing analysis to optimize campaign effectiveness. Create compelling storytelling that translates concepts into customer-centric value propositions that demonstrate understanding of customer needs and competitive differentiation. Collaborate closely with Sales, Product Management, R&D, regional marketing teams, and external partners to gather market insights and strengthen go-to-market effectiveness. Support local marketing and communications teams in localizing and developing industry campaigns. Qualifications Bachelor's or higher degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related fields. 5+ years of experience in related roles, ideally in B2B product marketing Proven experience building and executing impactful global marketing plans and integrated campaigns Proficiency in digital marketing tools, AI, analytics, and content development. Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder‑management skills. A mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement Fluency in English and valid work authorization in the hiring country. What's in it for you? We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward. Contribute to a collective vision. This is where progress takes flight, teams turn ideas into impact, and we define what’s next. Run What Runs the World.
